question: Can the boot identifiers and the install directory change to VerOS without leaving the loader and the CD pointing at different folders?
allowedInputs: boot/bootdata/bootcd.ini and boot/bootdata/txtsetup.sif, which name the boot type and the default install directory
boot/freeldr/freeldr/ntldr/setupldr.c, which accepts that boot type and searches the CD directory
The add_cd_file DESTINATION reactos lines, which place the system files in that CD directory
base/setup/lib/bootsup.c, which writes the FreeLoader section names
The user instruction to update boot identifiers and directory names to VerOS

cursor.prompt: Can we update boot identifiers and directory names to VerOS too?

measuredEffect.note: BootType changed from ReactOSSetup to VerOSSetup in the same pass. Source directories such as sdk/include/reactos and base/setup/reactos were not renamed. License notices were not changed.
